verdict.rationale: OpenAI publishes a structured API reference, for example the Responses create method page. Docs also include copy-pasteable code snippets such as npm install and tool configs, and the official Cookbook is a maintained library of worked code examples. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, in-browser 'try it' console, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404, so no machine-readable spec backs an interactive explorer. Missing for 10: interactive in-browser request execution in the reference, runnable (not just copyable) examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
